reuse.why: Writes one guard function but does not use the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount pipeline, which every provider already calls and which already receives syncSource, externalAccountId and upgradingId.

duplication.why: The query is defined once, but the same guard call is pasted into each of the five provider wrappers, restating the syncSource string and account id that each wrapper passes to linkBankSyncAccount a few lines later.

placement.why: The rule belongs with the shared link step in accounts/app.ts; putting the call in each provider wrapper (done so it runs before findOrCreateBank) spreads it across the per-provider layer instead of the shared one.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and correct in shape, but a future provider must remember to add the guard by hand because the shared link pipeline does not enforce it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Provider wrappers still route through linkBankSyncAccount; the guard is just placed beside it at each call site rather than inside it.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated guard calls are plain, not disguised.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked holds the whole rule and every provider link path calls it, though from five call sites rather than from linkBankSyncAccount.
